_help: Which music track plays where. Tracks are the WAV files in ShiftJamContent/Music (without .wav); each loops.
'title' plays on the title screen and the ending, 'default' for any stage not listed, 'stages' maps a campaign build id
(level:streets, boss:pell, keep ...) to a track. Drop in your own looping WAV with the same name to replace a track,
or add a new WAV and name it here. Run tools/sync_content.py after adding files. Volume: Tuning.MusicVolume in balance.json.
title: title
